name: Kingdoms
description: Two neighboring but politically divided realms: the Kingdom of Caldris, a wealthy river-coast power of guilds and scholars, and the Kingdom of Thornvale, a rugged highland realm of knightly houses and old rites.

locations.name: Sunport Docks
locations.description: Located in the Kingdom of Caldris. A busy harbor district of lateen ships, salt-stained warehouses, and foreign merchants trading under painted banners.

locations.name: Gilded Forum
locations.description: Located in the Kingdom of Caldris. A grand civic square ringed by counting houses, marble loggias, and fountain statues of long-dead merchant princes.

locations.name: Artificers Row
locations.description: Located in the Kingdom of Caldris. A narrow lane of alchemical glassworks, clockmaker stalls, and rune-etched mechanical curiosities humming after dusk.

locations.name: Marble Basilica
locations.description: Located in the Kingdom of Caldris. A domed temple where choir hymns blend with careful celestial rites performed by scholar-priests.

locations.name: Canal Ward
locations.description: Located in the Kingdom of Caldris. Stone bridges cross narrow canals lined with silk dyers, mask shops, and lantern-lit balconies over dark water.

locations.name: Skyglass Observatory
locations.description: Located in the Kingdom of Caldris. A hilltop observatory crowned with rotating brass instruments and a polished crystal lens for charting omens in the stars.

locations.name: Wolfgate Keep
locations.description: Located in the Kingdom of Thornvale. A granite fortress with wind-battered pennants, where oathbound retainers and stewards govern the highland marches.

locations.name: Emberfield Village
locations.description: Located in the Kingdom of Thornvale. A close-knit settlement of timber halls, smokehouses, and communal fire circles where ballads preserve family honor.

locations.name: Ironwood Hunt
locations.description: Located in the Kingdom of Thornvale. A deep old-growth forest of black pines and pale runestones, patrolled by wardens tracking beasts and spirits alike.

locations.name: Runecloister
locations.description: Located in the Kingdom of Thornvale. A secluded monastic hall where knight-scribes illuminate war chronicles and bind protective sigils into steel and leather.

locations.name: Stormwatch Cliffs
locations.description: Located in the Kingdom of Thornvale. A jagged coastal overlook where beacon braziers and wyvern-watch towers stand against relentless ocean winds.

locations.name: Moonmere Shrine
locations.description: Located in the Kingdom of Thornvale. A quiet lakeside shrine with silver reeds and mirrored water said to reveal truthful visions on clear nights.
